name: Delhi Family Benefit Scheme
benefit: One Time assistance of Rs 20,000/- is remitted to the bank account of the beneficiary as per the Aadhaar number/ account number of the beneficiary through PFMS portal.
eligibility_rules: The age of the deceased should be between 18 to 60 years, i.e. death of the "bread earner" occurred while he/she was in the age group 18-60 years. "Bread earner" is defined as the member of the household whose earnings contributed the largest proportion to the total household income. Resident of Delhi for more than 5 years before the date of applicationThe family income of the applicant should not be more than Rs 1,00,000/ per annum. The applicant should have an Aadhaar numberThe applicant should have a 'singly-operated' account in any Bank in the National Capital Territory of Delhi only for receiving the payment through Public Financial Management System (PFMS).
documents_required: documentsAge proof. Residence proof. Bank a/c number (Single a/c). This provision may be relaxed in the case of minors who can have a
bank account under guardianship. Death certificate of the bread earner. One passport
size photo of the applicant. Income self
in the format given on the portal itself.
how_to_apply: Mode: Online Application processApplication to be made online on the e-District portal www.edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in by registering through citizen log-in or by approaching the concerned District Social Welfare Office. An Aadhaar number is mandatory for filling up the application- without Aadhaar, the application portal will not work. Self-attested documentary.
